s: noun
(Greek mythology) a maiden seduced by Zeus; when Hera was about to discover them together Zeus turned her into a white heifer
دختری از اساطیر یونان که زئوس عاشقش شد و هرا او را به گاو سفید تبدیل کرد
In Greek mythology, Io was transformed into a white heifer by Zeus.
noun
the closest of Jupiter's moons; has active volcanoes

noun

The lab technician added potassium iodide to the chemical solution.
verb
cause to combine with iodine
ترکیب دادن با ید
iodinate thyroxine
noun
a nonmetallic element belonging to the halogens; used especially in medicine and photography and in dyes; occurs naturally only in combination in small quantities (as in sea water or rocks)
ید (عنصر شیمیایی)
Iodine is an essential element found naturally in seawater and used widely in medicine.
noun
a tincture consisting of a solution of iodine in ethyl alcohol; applied topically to wounds as an antiseptic
تنتور ید (محلول ضدعفونی‌کننده)
noun

ذره باردار الکتریکی
When salt dissolves in water, it breaks apart into sodium and chloride ions.
adjective
containing or involving or occurring in the form of ions

adjective

noun

noun
a tiny or scarcely detectable amount
مقدار بسیار کم، ذره‌ای
I don't care one iota about what other people think of me.
noun
the 9th letter of the Greek alphabet
